verified_main_commits.change: Complete rational distributional inverse Laplace transforms
Complete finite solution recovery through checked radicals

features.implemented: Matrix.solve and LUsolve admit bounded nonsquare exact-rational systems with multiple RHS columns, then require independently checked unique affine solutions for every column. Inconsistency and nonuniqueness remain explicit; all columns share cumulative budgets and no partial solution is published. Existing square behavior is retained.
features.scope: Dimensions and RHS columns at most 128, 4096-bit input coefficients and aggregate work bound. Native symbolic/opaque rectangular coefficients remain unsupported. Public empty-shape and mutable/immutable/sparse RHS class conventions follow pinned upstream probes.
regressions: Late RHS inconsistency cannot publish earlier columns
Zero dimensions, coefficient/aggregate bounds, square-path regression

features.implemented: Checked coordinate elimination proposes square-free annihilators. An independent composition checker proves both ideal inclusions using exact original/augmented-input binding, coefficient Bezout identities, dense reference powers and independently checked original-basis membership. The resulting radical preserves every complex point.
features.scope: QQ, 1..8 typed variables, at most 64 generators, degree/term/coefficient caps and independent cumulative phase budgets. Immutable in-process receipts only; no new portable kernel claim. Positive-dimensional input refuses.
regressions: Coupled nilpotents and a 15-dimensional quintic quotient
Exact ring/source binding and missing original equations
Cancellation/exhaustion in both phases and before publication

features.implemented: After existing original-shape and seven separating-form attempts genuinely miss, checked radicalization enables another bounded RUR search. Exact augmented-to-original binding and recovered original residuals are checked independently. The coupled quintic system q(x)^2=q(x)*y=y^2=0 now returns all five distinct real points through the existing native/public dispatcher.
features.scope: Existing successful paths keep original multiplicities. Radical fallback exposes reduced-quotient multiplicities and preserves distinct points. Nonreal roots remain visible to the complex-completeness guard. Unsupported, exhausted and cancelled cases do not become empty sets.
regressions: All five quintic points in either caller variable order
Legacy UnsupportedDegree and nonlinsolve component-probe reachability
Irreducible x^5+5*x+5 reaches the intended one-real/four-nonreal guard

features.area: WS18 rational and delayed distributional transforms
features.implemented: Polynomial parts of rational transforms produce Dirac delta derivatives under the unilateral 0-minus convention. The reference checker reconstructs the strictly proper regular transform and checks P*B+R=A. Delayed certificates independently reconstruct every original delay group, check each complete identity, and shift both regular and impulse components using exact typed substitution. Only regular functions receive Heaviside multipliers.
features.scope: Degree at most 32, exact rational coefficients and nonnegative rational delays, bounded finite sums/products, repeated supported linear/quadratic poles. Original exclusions, combined output limits and independent cumulative phase budgets are retained. Existing ordinary-only Rust APIs remain separate. Unsupported regular tails refuse the whole source; no partial impulses are published.
regressions: Every admitted derivative order 0..32, with and without delay
Missing/duplicated/reordered delay groups and tiny coefficient mutations
Held original domains, same-named typed symbols and exact cancellation
Budget exhaustion and cancellation through final publication
